description: This file implements the MD5 message-digest algorithm, including core functions, update, finalization, and utility functions for computing MD5 hashes.

classes.name: MD5Context
classes.description: Structure used to hold the state of an ongoing MD5 computation.

classes.name: MD5Digest
classes.description: Structure representing the 16-byte MD5 hash digest.

methods.name: MD5Update
methods.description: Updates the MD5 context with new data.

methods.name: MD5Final
methods.description: Finalizes the MD5 computation and produces the digest.

methods.name: MD5DigestToBase16
methods.description: Converts the MD5 digest to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: MD5Sum
methods.description: Computes the MD5 digest for a given data buffer.

methods.name: MD5String
methods.description: Computes the MD5 hash of a string and returns it as a hex string.
